summary: Constructor for a dual linked-list manager object that owns socket-address storage and a mutex. Zero-initializes the eight list-manager dwords (this+0x0..0x1C), allocates a 4-byte node and an 8316-byte block, initializes two 4156-byte SocketAddress slots inside the block via NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH_a6eb with the SocketAddressInit callback and EmptyStub_aa60, stores the block base into the node, appends the node through LinkedListNodeAppend_6000, pre-allocates two empty list nodes via LinkedListNodeAllocPrepend across the slots, sets this+0x20/0x24/0x28 to 0/-1/0, creates an unnamed mutex with CreateMutexA into this+0x20, and sets the byte flag at this+0x28 to 1 only when the mutex handle is non-zero.

local_names.v2: 4-byte node object allocated to hold the SocketAddress block pointer
local_names.v3: 8316-byte SocketAddress block; header dword 2, followed by two 4156-byte slots at v3+1
local_names.v9: start of the two SocketAddress slots inside the block (v3+1)
local_names.v10: node pointer finally linked (v2) or null on allocation failure

operations.description: Zero-initialize the eight list-manager dwords this+0x0 through this+0x1C (both list heads/tails/cursors/counts).
OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(4) allocates the 4-byte node object into v2.
SEH-guarded allocation: OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(8316) allocates the 8316-byte SocketAddress block into v3; the exception landing pad SEH_581FD0 covers this allocation region.
Set the block header *v3 = 2 and compute v9 = v3+1, the start of the two SocketAddress slots.

NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH_a6eb(v3+1, 4156, 2, SocketAddressInit, EmptyStub_aa60) initializes two SocketAddress elements of 4156 bytes each inside the block, using SocketAddressInit as the per-element callback and EmptyStub_aa60 as the empty-stub callback.
Store the SocketAddress block base into the node: *v2 = v9.
LinkedListNodeAppend_6000(v10, 1) appends the node to the first linked list.
Pre-allocation loop: for i stepping 4156 from 0 while i < 8312, LinkedListNodeAllocPrepend(i + *v10, 0) pre-allocates two empty list nodes across the two SocketAddress slots.
Initialize the mutex/state fields: this+0x20 = 0, this+0x24 = -1, byte this+0x28 = 0.
CreateMutexA(&MutexAttributes, 0, 0) creates an unnamed mutex (default SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES, inherit handle) and its handle is stored to this+0x20.
Only when the CreateMutexA result is non-zero is the byte flag at this+0x28 set to 1, marking the mutex as valid.
Return this: the constructor returns the fully initialized object.
Constructed from sub_57BA10 (the single static caller of this constructor).
